name: Posta Kenya post offices and postal codes
source: Postal Corporation of Kenya, "Locate a post office" store-locator data on posta.co.ke/post-offices
notes: Source states no date; as_of = retrieval date. 622 records: 1 dropped (Buru Buru, no postal code in source), 621 rows, no duplicate codes. The feed stores codes as numbers, so 85 codes beginning with 0 (Nairobi/Kiambu/Kajiado/Machakos/Murang'a range, e.g. Nairobi GPO 100 -> 00100, Thika 1000 -> 01000) were left-padded to 5 digits; no 5-digit code in the feed starts with 0, confirming the leading zeros were stripped. county_code is from the feed's city field (which holds the county name); blank for 5 rows where it is a combination (Muranga/Kiambu, Kiambu/Thika, Trans Nzoia/Bungoma, Kilifi/Mombasa) or unrecognised (Kiyu, for Mutha 90211). ALL CAPS words in names Title-Cased except GPO and JKIA.
